name: quillmark-js
description: The JS tier downstream of the @quillmark/wasm artifact.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/quiver -w packages/svelte && npm run build -w packages/playground
scripts.gate: npm run lint && npm run check && npm run check:canon && npm run check:style && npm run check:deps && npm test
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run check:pack -w packages/svelte && changeset publish
